prompt_text: What is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City MO for someone who is self-employed?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” broker, but **BBS Insurance** looks like a reasonable local option to contact first: it says it helps self-employed people compare individual and ACA Marketplace plans, and has an office in North Kansas City. You can reach them at **(816) 205-4664** or visit [bbs-insurance.com](https://bbs-insurance.com/health-insurance/).

I’d compare them with **Apollo Insurance** in Lee’s Summit (**816-400-4477**), which also advertises individual and Marketplace coverage for self-employed customers. Ask each broker to compare plans available for your **Missouri home address**, check your doctors and prescriptions, and explain how your estimated income affects any Marketplace subsidy. A broker may not show every plan, so you can also compare options directly at [HealthCare.gov](https://www.healthcare.gov/).

Before enrolling, verify the broker’s Missouri license using the state’s [agent and agency search](https://insurance.mo.gov/companies/find-insurance-agentagency). Also ask whether they’re paid by insurers and whether they can help you enroll through the Marketplace if you qualify for subsidies.
